sources.title: invenio: Recherche im Bundesarchiv
sources.scopeNote: The public catalog may describe material that remains access-restricted; a catalog hit is not a digitized file.

sources.title: Using the National Archives Catalog
sources.publisher: US National Archives and Records Administration
sources.scopeNote: Catalog descriptions and digital objects are different levels of access; restricted records may have public descriptions.

sources.title: How do Onion Services work?
sources.scopeNote: Explains address and service authentication; it does not identify a historical source or authorize access to one.

sources.title: US letter and declassified drone comparison, S/2023/661
sources.publisher: United States, submitted to UN Security Council
sources.scopeNote: US comparison of drone debris from northern Iraq and Ukraine; UN hosting does not make this an independent UN finding.

sources.title: Iranian response to S/2023/661, S/2023/683
sources.publisher: Islamic Republic of Iran, submitted to UN Security Council
sources.scopeNote: Iran disputes the US drone evidence; the response is a party statement, not an independent forensic test.

sources.title: Secretary-General report on resolution 2231, S/2023/975
sources.scopeNote: The report records the US submission and Iranian/Russian disputes; its reporting of those submissions is not a second independent debris examination.

relations.basis: The Iranian letter names S/2023/661 as the letter it answers.
The Secretary-General report recounts the US submission as a party claim.
The Secretary-General report recounts the Iranian response as a party claim.

questions.title: Which exact surviving HV-A/SIRA unit answers one named research question?
questions.nextEvidence: An exact catalog signature, its archival level, access terms and the original record if lawfully available.
questions.reopenTrigger: A publicly retrievable item identifier or an archive response with a specific signature.

questions.title: Can the Iraq/Ukraine component comparison be checked outside the submitting parties?
questions.nextEvidence: A separately provenienced forensic examination of the same identifiable components and documented chain of custody.
questions.reopenTrigger: An accessible independent component report with images, identifiers and acquisition history.

questions.title: Does a specific public onion service contain a relevant primary record?
questions.nextEvidence: An exact service address published by its operator, lawful access scope, named record and reproducible capture metadata.
questions.reopenTrigger: A concrete public service and document identifier tied to one existing research question.
